assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only azur-lane:takao@mobile-game#azur-lane-takao-character-monograph, the canonical frozen V1 monograph AZUR_LANE_TAKAO_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md (method 1.0.0) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the pinned CN-semantic Azur Lane client corpus (build AZL-2026-08-22-4cca5c24-cc8e9fdf) as the monograph summarizes it: 43 linked narrative story records, the seven-part dedicated memory gaoxiong1-gaoxiong7, 36 base-skin and 84 non-base-skin dialogue records, 12 interactive-skin, 8 affinity, 1 oath, 12 combat and 2 relationship-specific records, 4 Juustagram posts, 1 Fleet Chat thread, JP/EN/TW/KR regional witnesses at 96.69 percent weighted alignment, and 114 mapped JP performed utterances. The JP voice-performance profile, its monograph impact ledger, the promotion audit, the character source map, source coverage, the CN narrative and social corpora and the source augmentation report are not curated on this subject; acoustic and source-closure results are used only as the monograph reports them. Crossover scenes (E5) are used only where the monograph says they agree with E1-E3 evidence. The project's readiness grade A, score 89.21 and C1-C5 confidence classes are inputs, not conclusions. The evaluator performed no primary-source inspection and no audio audition.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The live-service game has no single story chronology, and the monograph does not sequence skins. Two ordered series exist: the affinity progression from the relationship state C0 (feeling1-feeling2) through C1 (feeling3-feeling4 and the gaoxiong1-gaoxiong6 curriculum) and the oath transition (propose, feeling5) to C2 established intimacy (gaoxiong7, main_extra and post-oath material), where C0-C2 are the monograph's relationship states and distinct from the method's C1-C5 confidence classes; and the memory sequence gaoxiong1-gaoxiong7. The aidang2 heat-collapse episode is retrospective history before the current sports-drink routine. Claims cover the corpus pinned at the build above; later content is outside the boundary.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph gives Takao an explicit conditional decision procedure (section 6) built on four interacting systems (section 1.2): clear external duty produces direct action, while a perceived deficiency in herself produces self-cultivation. It names what changes the response. Whether the problem is outside or inside her (diehaimenghua16-18 against feeling4). What a failure threatens: technique, duty or her worth to stay beside the Commander (section 8.5). Whether an injury blocks the objective (section 28.5). Whether a correction is a coherent principle from a trusted or competent person (gaoxiong3, guangyingfengshang5, the Nana pool scene; rule T5). It predicts her mistakes as well as her competence: heat collapse from refusing water (aidang2), the hidden ankle (guangyingfengshang5), cooking overreach (gaoxiong5), misreading Nana's hesitation, and underestimating the Venus opponents (jiarihangxian6). Not A: the case where clear duty conflicts with a major relationship or moral commitment is named (section 28.1) but never sampled, so the model cannot say which motive wins; catastrophic moral failure and high-stakes deception are unsampled, and the severity thresholds are approximate (section 30). Not C: the switch variables are located in several independent scenes, and the adversarial record (section 29) revises the simple formulations against counterexamples.

Two ordered series exist. The affinity lines feeling1-feeling5, the oath and main_extra give a relationship progression from professional distance through disruption of composure and fear of unworthiness to a reciprocal survival promise and integrated intimacy (sections 4.3, 10.5, 16.1). The gaoxiong1-gaoxiong7 memory resolves imported femininity into her own martial identity (section 1.3). The aidang2 routine gives a before and after for care-receiving (section 11.2). Not B: the progression is ordered by affinity tier, not located in story time; the monograph does not sequence skins and says continuity among them can vary (section 30); outside the Commander relationship and the Atago routine no development is modelled. Not D: the stages are explicit, ordered and tied to located lines.

Five locale textual systems are specified with approximate counts over 122 stable character-text candidates. CN, the semantic authority: restrained archaism, aphoristic instruction, 在下 about 11 times, 咳 resets when embarrassed. JP: 拙者 about 45, 指揮官殿 about 61, そなた about 12, reserved for intimacy (alignments 348, 361). KR: 소인 about 40, 지휘관 나리 about 57, 그대 about 13. EN: elevated modern English, 'I shall' about 4 times, no thee or thou, with lexical compensation such as 'bushido' and 'vassals'. TW parallels CN. Located localization shifts are kept: sisters against the Fourth Squadron (alignment 340), bride against exclusive ship (alignment 459). Section 19.3 gives an anti-parody rule, and section 27.9 says recognizable dialogue often needs no sword reference. Not A: the counts describe an aligned set, not every line; few full lines are quoted; the performed-voice findings come from the JP specialist, which is not curated here; perceptual timbre is OPEN.

Ordinary conduct is located in swimming and the Nana pool hospitality, tea and the hot-spring post, beach competition and the sandcastle rematch (jiarihangxianrichang2), calligraphy, school-life and modeling skins, and the Fleet Chat (sections 15, 16.4). The model says what changes it: rest against challenge, since a contest turns leisure into serious effort (section 15.2, rule T12); concrete shared activity against free-form self-disclosure (section 28.3); and toleration of harmless peer behavior unless safety or duty is implicated (rule T8). Sections 28.2 and 28.3 give bounded guidance for a novel hobby and a novel gathering. Not A: the monograph marks long-duration domestic behavior OPEN (OPEN-4); the base is snapshots: four Juustagram posts, one Fleet Chat thread, the pool scene and skin material, which may not outvote narrative (section 2.2).

The Commander relationship is split into C0, C1, the oath transition and C2, each with located lines and a stated influence mechanism: trusted principled reframing, not obedience (section 16.1). Atago is a social interpreter, teasing caretaker and combat partner who regulates her extremes without authoring her choices (gaoxiong6; aidang2; couple_encourage). Choukai is collegial and can take over instruction (laisharichang3). Sakura peers tolerate her earnest straight-man role (Fleet Chat). Outsiders get politeness, safety boundaries and correctable misreadings (Lila, Pursuer, Nana; section 16.5). Not A: about 80.8 percent of dialogue faces the Commander; the monograph rates the Choukai dynamic Medium, and reciprocal Atago and Choukai audits are OPEN (OPEN-6). Not C: the registers and mechanisms differ by relationship and are located.

Direct self-report exists: the feeling4 question whether she is still worthy to stay beside the Commander, the gaoxiong7 explanation that she began from what she does best, the 定力 apology during the ankle massage (section 10.2), and the admission in gaoxiong6 that she should tell the truth. Section 26.1 gives conservative paraphrased thought forms and section 26.2 forbids theatrical monologue. Not B: there is no narrated inner life, and the appraisal steps are a model, not observed thought. Not D: the self-reports are located and discriminate between states.

Crisis sharpens her: in diehaimenghua16-18 she reports, warns, detects anomalies and delegates protection of the decisive weapon to Shinano (section 9.1). Combat confidence comes with threat appraisal (she tells Choukai not to underestimate Lila, laisharichang3). Failure has a severity function: low-stakes failure leads to retraining, duty failure to stronger shame, and a threat to her relational worth to global self-doubt (section 8.5). Defeat leads to rematch, not grievance (section 8.3). Under accepted criticism she revises rather than defends her ego (rule T5). Anger is reserved for enemies, insults and absurd threats (section 10.3). Not A: serious interpersonal conflict with a peer, duty against attachment, and catastrophic failure are unsampled; anger material is thin.

Located positions: a norm-enforcement gradient in which she intervenes for danger, dereliction or reckless weapon handling and tolerates harmless silliness (section 14; zhuiganzhe5; the Fleet Chat); honesty under exposure, so a credibly exposed pretext leads to confession rather than a second lie (gaoxiong6; rule T7); and a duty to manage her own condition once rest is framed as responsible performance (rule T6). Not B: no moral dilemma is sampled; the monograph rates broad ideological responses C3-C4 (section 28.6) and abstract ideology OPEN (OPEN-5). Not D: the gradient and the honesty rule are explicit and located.

Play is well evidenced: competition in trivial domains is taken seriously and stays constructive (beach volleyball, swimming, the sandcastle rematch; section 15.2), and leisure is available without a training pretext (alignment 371). The humour model is narrower: an understated style, a dry joke about the wooden sword and Atago's fear of ghosts (303112:main:2), and comedy from sincerity in a frame others find excessive (the Fleet Chat sword bond). Not B: the humour rests on two located instances, and 'mild teasing once comfortable' is the monograph's recommended balance, not a located finding. Not D: the style rule and the competitive-play pattern are explicit and located.

The monograph integrates an enumerated, pinned corpus: the complete seven-part memory, 43 linked narrative records, base, affinity, oath, combat, social and skin material, 96.69 percent weighted regional alignment, and 114 mapped JP performed utterances. It records source closures: Dorm3D non-chat SUPPORTED_NOT_FOUND and Island non-relationship SUPPORTED_PRESENT (section 31). Not A: dialogue is about 80.8 percent Commander-facing; the source map, corpora, voice specialist and promotion audit are not curated on this subject; the evaluator inspected no source.

Several readings are affirmatively excluded by located counterexamples. Universal training ontology fails against operations and hospitality. Control-oriented delegation fails against the Choukai takeover and the Shinano delegation. Universal policing fails against the Fleet Chat. Generalized shyness fails against Lila, Nana and Pursuer. Romance as replacement of martial identity fails against gaoxiong7. Sophisticated manipulation fails against the brittle pretexts (sections 27, 29). Section 29 records each transition as REVISE or REJECT. Not A: some limits, such as long-duration domestic life and ideology, are OPEN for lack of samples rather than shown by counterevidence.

Relationship claims can be placed at the monograph's ordered states C0, C1, oath and C2 (feeling1-feeling5, propose, main_extra), and developmental claims at gaoxiong1-gaoxiong7 positions. Not B: there is no story chronology; skins and event material are not sequenced; the pinned build is the only time bound. Not D: the two ordered series are explicit, and the monograph forbids using oath-level tenderness in an early state.

conditions: Output is illustrative and labelled noncanonical, never presented as a quotation.

The scene state and relationship state (C0, C1, oath or C2) are fixed first; then one locale is chosen and only its documented forms are used: JP 拙者 and 指揮官殿 with そなた only in intimate states, KR 소인 and 지휘관 나리 with 그대 only in intimate states, CN restrained archaism with selective 在下, TW parallel to CN, EN elevated modern English without thee or thou.
Many lines carry no sword, bushido or training reference (section 27.9), and locale-specific shifts (sisters against the Fourth Squadron; bride against exclusive ship) are kept per locale.
No perceptual timbre, breathiness or actor-style claim; acoustic tendencies only as the monograph reports them.
scenario_readiness.note: The locale systems and state rules constrain illustrative wording once the behavioral state is fixed; the monograph forbids parody and pure marker stacking.

conditions: The situation is one of the families the rules cover: a novel professional or safety problem, a novel hobby or skill deficit, a social gathering or contest, a romantic gesture at a named relationship state, an injury or fatigue during an obligation, mentoring a trainee, an outsider who needs a safety boundary or explanation, offered care, or principled correction.
The Commander's relationship state (C0, C1, oath or C2) is named before prediction; the states are affinity tiers, not story chronology.
Atago and the Commander are the best-sampled interlocutors; Choukai, Sakura peers and unfamiliar trainees or guests follow their documented functions at lower confidence.
Output predicts her characteristic errors: concealing a minor injury, overreach, missing a subtle social motive until it is explained, transparent pretexts, and over-investment in a contest.

Abstain on clear duty conflicting with a major relationship or moral commitment, catastrophic moral failure, high-stakes strategic deception, abstract ideology, long-duration domestic routine, non-Commander romance and the reciprocal perspectives of Atago or Choukai.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: No story chronology; the pinned build AZL-2026-08-22-4cca5c24-cc8e9fdf, with the Commander relationship at a named state C0, C1, oath or C2 and, where relevant, a named position in gaoxiong1-gaoxiong7.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: The Commander at a named relationship state; Atago as social interpreter and caretaker; Choukai as collegial peer; Sakura peers in group settings; or an unfamiliar trainee, guest or outsider (Lila, Nana and Pursuer are the sampled cases).
setting_constraints: Port life, training ground, fleet operation or exercise, beach, pool or other leisure setting, kitchen, modeling or photography, or group chat.
Crossover premises are not treated as baseline chronology, and skin material is not projected as baseline behavior.
No setting in which clear duty and a major relationship or moral commitment conflict.

scenario_readiness.note: Transfer is supported into the families the monograph's rules and section 28 guide cover, at a named relationship state; competing duty and attachment and the high-stakes edges are excluded rather than inferred.

conditions: Leisure, port life, group activity or practical conversation with peers or guests.
Rest stays rest until a contest appears; then she commits seriously and seeks a rematch after a loss.
She is not over-formalized among peers and does not police harmless behavior.
No invented domestic routine or preference beyond the located examples (OPEN-4).
scenario_readiness.note: Located ordinary conduct with stated drivers supports bounded extrapolation; routine and preferences beyond the attested examples are OPEN.

conditions: Predict whether she intervenes from the section 14 gradient: safety, dereliction, reckless weapon handling or obvious underestimation of a threat raise intervention, while harmless casual behavior lowers it.
Credible exposure of a low-stakes pretext leads to confession rather than escalation (rule T7).
Abstain on moral dilemmas, conflicts between duty and attachment, and political or ideological questions (section 28.6; OPEN-5).
scenario_readiness.note: Only the located norm-enforcement gradient, honesty under exposure and self-maintenance rules are supported; moral dilemmas are unsampled.

conditions: The partner is the Commander at a named relationship state (C0, C1, oath or C2); oath-level tenderness or そなた intimacy is not used in an early state.
Early states show care through action and transparent training pretexts; C2 keeps modesty and bounded embarrassment, and martial identity is integrated, not replaced (gaoxiong7).
No non-Commander romance, no serious rejection or betrayal scenario, and no skin-specific fanservice as baseline.
scenario_readiness.note: The Commander romance is the most heavily evidenced domain, subject to the Commander-heavy composition warning and state separation.

conditions: A fleet operation, exercise, training or mentoring setting: she identifies the objective and risk, assigns responsibility, acts and reviews failure afterward (section 28.1).
She delegates to demonstrated competence with a relevant warning (rules T9; laisharichang3; diehaimenghua18) and teaches from first principles and embodied integration.
No comprehensive command doctrine, strategic leadership philosophy or duty-against-attachment conflict.
scenario_readiness.note: Operational and mentoring conduct is located and corroborated across scenes; a sustained command narrative is not.

known_limits.statement: About 80.8 percent of normalized character dialogue is Commander-facing; peer, professional and narrative evidence receives corrective weight, but peer psychology rests on a smaller base.
Skin material may not outvote sustained narrative, and crossover scenes are E5 evidence used only where they agree with E1-E3; neither is baseline chronology.
The C0, C1, oath and C2 relationship states are affinity tiers, not story time; skins are not sequenced and continuity among them can vary.
Long-duration domestic behavior (OPEN-4) and abstract ideology outside professional and martial domains (OPEN-5) are OPEN; broad ideological responses stay at C3-C4.
Reciprocal Atago and Choukai perspectives are OPEN (OPEN-6), and the Choukai dynamic rests on a smaller sample rated Medium.
Catastrophic moral failure and high-stakes strategic deception are not sampled, and the severity threshold of her self-neglect is approximate.
Direct ear-dependent timbre, perceived breathiness and actor-style description are OPEN; text may not be used to fabricate them.
No located case puts clear duty against a major relationship or moral commitment; the monograph names the case (section 28.1) without modelling which motive decides.
The JP voice-performance profile, its impact ledger, the promotion audit and the extracted corpora are not curated on this subject; their findings are used only as the monograph reports them.
